The host plays an analysis by the YouTuber Nicci (A-2537.1) arguing that the back-camera footage Terryl Farnsworth showed the host over FaceTime was likely zoomed in or cropped. Nicci's clip compares it with wide-angle back-camera shots from other 2025 American Comeback Tour stops. The host adds the opening of her FaceTime call with Terryl (A-2538.1), in which she says he opens a drive she suspects is the camera's SD card on his desktop in Scottsdale. She says that in their September 17 and 19 conversations Terryl never told her he lacked the footage or had given the SD card to federal agents. She also notes that Charlie Kirk was seated on a new platform and that, by her review, the camera directly behind his head first appeared in 2025 (A-2539).

According to an unverified tip the host relays (A-2540.1), in late 2016 Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta met the holders of a pending patent for an interchangeable-caliber gun. The tip says the four had dinner in Scottsdale, where Lori and Larry offered access to government contracts and Erika Frantzve arrived unannounced. The host says Erika was then dating Cabot Phillips, not Charlie Kirk, and that nothing came of the deal. She links this to Victor Marx's interest in the Fold AR patent and to her view that Jeffrey Epstein began his career in weapons trafficking.

The host rebuts a Blake Neff X post calling her dishonest about whether Tyler Robinson's parents recognized the rifle (A-2541.1). She cites a Daily Mail headline (A-2541.2) and a Robinson text message from the charging document (A-2541.3). She again asks TPUSA to answer donors' claims that Charlie never named Erika his successor at Aspen. She then reads Laura Loomer's "God hates you" tweet (A-2542.1) and quotes a 2019 Spectator profile in which Loomer described cocaine use, a suicide attempt and social-media addiction (A-2542.2).

In the comments segment the host discusses the continuance fight in the Robinson case and asks for tips on whether Charlie Kirk's body was cremated (A-2543.1). She also notes newly added lines in Robinson's messages, comments on Kash Patel's suit against The Atlantic, and announces an interview with Corby Hall after Victor Marx declined to join him.

blocks.header: **N-10828** Lori Frantzve 2016 Gun Patent Dinner
blocks.label: Lori Frantzve 2016 Gun Patent Dinner

lines.v: Event

a tip that in late fall 2016 Lori Frantzve and Larry Guinta met two holders of a pending patent for an interchangeable-caliber gun. The tip says they met at a Salt Lake City expo where Lori was promoting G-Tech Industries' EMP technology. They then held a dinner in Scottsdale, offered an introduction to their G-Tech angel investor and claimed access to government contracts. According to the tip, Erika Frantzve arrived unannounced, and her mother mentioned that Erika was dating a man with big political connections. The host says nothing came of the deal, the patent is now approved, and the patent holder later had a lawsuit with Victor Marx.

lines: - **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2540.1 (tip on the 2016 Scottsdale gun-patent dinner) and A-2543.1 (cremation tip request). The Aspen audio or video, Erika Kirk's Fox News burial answer, the MSN article, Trump's "mentally ill" post and the Robinson affidavits are referenced but not shown and have no artifact.

- **DIA scan**: real hits at 00:49:03 and 00:49:43 are inscribed (C-8542, C-8543, A-2543.1, A-2543.2, M-12). Not DIA beats: "candaceowens. com" at 00:43:49 is a merch and subscription plug. "Our tips box" at 01:22 and "a stunning tip" at 00:01 and 15:52 describe tips already received rather than a solicitation; they are noted here but not inscribed as separate DIA beats.

- **Name matching**: "Nicci"/"Niecy" are mapped to N-563 Nicey (YouTuber). "Terryl" and "Tarrio" (49:43; also "Tarrio Robinson" at 51:43–52:39, evidently Tyler Robinson) are mapped to N-261 Terryl Farnsworth only where the camera operator is meant. "Blake enough" (00:01) is read as Blake Neff (N-159). "Blake" among those who did not call 911 is assumed to be Blake Neff, which is uncertain. "Lori Frantzbe" and "Larry Guinta" are mapped to N-489 and N-387. "Xavier Boussard" is mapped to N-283 Xavier Poussard. "Ashley" (09:05, a producer) is unidentified and not mapped to the existing Ashley Rindsberg node. "Jillian" (01:22), the then 15-year-old in Nicci's earlier text-message investigation, is likely the existing Jillian Falcon node but is not cited in a claim. Paula White Cain, Hillary Clinton, Ben Shapiro, Judge Judy and Jimmy Barbecue (Jimmy Cherizier) are named only in passing or in jokes and are not cited.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "Wiyre Fy" is read as the Yrefy sponsor (N-10791). "send him some kid" is "kit". "maca hats" is "MACA hats" (Make America Christian Again). "Shayna FK" (44:48) is unclear. "that meaning" (20:24) is likely "that meeting". "I'm looking at you, Larry" (50:27, viewer comment) apparently refers to Laura Loomer. The viewer comment at 54:08 says "Blake Masters" where Blake Neff is meant.
- **Tip reliability**: the 2016 dinner account (C-8510–C-8517) is a single unnamed tipster's account relayed with "allegedly"; neither the gun, the patent holders nor the restaurant is named.

- **Cross-episode links left out**: C-8535 may restate C-8434 (ep 94, Trump post mentioning "mentally ill") or C-7955 (ep 89). C-8511 may restate C-8168 or C-8332 (ep 91/93, Marx's Fold AR and Israeli Defense Group). C-8500 relates to C-4072 (ep 47, TPUSA defended the camera removal). C-8538 relates to C-8405 (ep 94, Erika's speedy-trial motion). The propositions differ or the match is uncertain, so these links are omitted.
- The "boiling the frog" theory that TPUSA introduced the setup gradually
- The idea that the zoomed-out footage "would solve Charlie's murder"
- "her and her mom are like Bonnie and Clyde"
- The view that Epstein's network re-emerged in the not-for-profit world (the host's own speculation)
- Characterizations of Loomer as "demonic" or needing an exorcism, and of Trump as "possessed" or needing an intervention
- Viewer Bigfoot believer's speculation that the shot came from Charlie's left and was hidden by the zoom
- Jokes about being "a big deal in Haiti" and Cabot Phillips at the "toddler park"

- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: Club Candace tiers merged at $11.99 a month or $120 a year; the book club; Charlie was 6'5"; the host tabled with Charlie from 2017 to 2024, from the East Coast to Hawaii.
- **Sponsor reads** (Pre-Born, Nimi Skincare, PureTalk, Fatty15) are excluded.
